lines.zh: 被你看着，我只能这样走
lines.en: While you watch, this is how I must walk.
I shift half a step toward where you stand.
In the fog I am only an outline.
My foot lifts, then settles gently down.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我得保持形状
lines.en: You stare, so I must hold this shape.
The ground is wet; I walk slowly.
I walk along the line of your gaze.
This form is heavy to move in.

lines.zh: 在你注视下我靠近三格
lines.en: Under your gaze I close three blocks.
Do not look away, or I will come apart.
You retreat, and my shape shifts with you.

lines.zh: 我踩着你留下的热气走
lines.en: I walk on the warmth you left behind.

lines.zh: 你看着我时，我一动不动
lines.en: While you watch me, I do not move at all.

lines.zh: 我的形状由你的目光撑着
lines.en: Your gaze is what holds my shape together.
I am counting how many times you blink.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命在流动
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health moves under my skin.
A hundred armor plates sit quietly closed.
The blink will come from you, not from me.
Standing still costs the least effort.
My shadow is nailed to the ground.

lines.zh: 风把我的边缘吹得很薄
lines.en: The wind thins the edges of me.
The torch in your hand is crackling.
Slowly I memorize your outline.
A bird calls far away; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 这个姿势我维持了一夜
lines.en: I have held this pose all night long.
I wonder why you still have not left.
You see me too; good.
The longer you look, the clearer I become.
My eyes have no pupils in them.

lines.zh: 你在我的注视里变慢了
lines.en: You slow down under my stare.
Do not be afraid; I am only looking.
You move your gaze aside by an inch.

lines.zh: 我脸的位置什么都没有
lines.en: There is nothing where my face should be.
Your own shadow is watching me too.
Three hundred seconds, and you are still looking.
I am waiting for that one blink.
The watched shape is the most human one.
You step back; my face turns to follow.
Do not check the mirror; I am not in it.
My outline is inside your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔在放大，我看得见
lines.en: Your pupils are widening; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我这张脸是照着你想出来的
lines.en: This face was shaped from what you imagine.

lines.zh: 你盯着的其实是自己的恐惧
lines.en: What you stare at is your own fear.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你却越来越累
lines.en: I hold still, yet you grow more tired.

lines.zh: 别只看我的脸，看看脚下
lines.en: Don't just watch my face; watch your feet.

lines.zh: 你的视线一转，我就换个位置
lines.en: The moment your gaze turns, I move.
The sword passes through me like fog.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命没那么容易
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health does not fall easily.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方又长回来了
lines.en: The place you struck has grown back.

lines.zh: 百层护甲护着这个形状
lines.en: A hundred armor plates protect this shape.
I feel no pain, only a slight waver.

lines.zh: 你的手停了一下，我看见了
lines.en: Your hand paused; I saw it.
Break half of me; half remains.
Do not stop; keep cutting.
The wound's edges are slowly realigning.
You use a sword; I use my gaze.
You hold up a lamp; I keep away from it.

lines.zh: 食物会让我变成别的形状
lines.en: Food would change me into another shape.

lines.zh: 你想用面包换我的注视
lines.en: You would trade bread for my gaze.
I do not eat; I am only seen.
That lamp is brighter than the bread.

lines.zh: 你手心的热气我感觉得到
lines.en: I can feel the heat of your palm.
Take it further away; I do not want to change.
I can see your bait quite clearly.
Hunger is not the thing that pulls me here.
Keep your rations for yourself.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，形状晃了一下
lines.en: You touch me, and my shape wavers.
My touch is colder than my outline suggests.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我的袖子
lines.en: Your hand passed through my sleeve.
Do not push; I will grow back.
A hundred armor plates sit under my skin.
That bump, and I have remembered you.
I held my ground while your boot slid backward.

lines.zh: 你肩上的温度留在我这
lines.en: The warmth of your shoulder stays on me.
Do not look elsewhere while touching me.
My edges are thin; do not tear them.

lines.zh: 被注视的形状不需要同类
lines.en: The watched shape needs no kin.

lines.zh: 你看着，我就只是我自己
lines.en: While you look, I am only myself.

lines.zh: 再多一个注视者就太挤
lines.en: One more Watcher would be too crowded.
My only mate is that stare of yours.
This fog has room for only one shape.
Do not find me a mate; I would come apart.

lines.zh: 同类碰面，谁都不敢眨眼
lines.en: When kin meet, neither dares to blink.
Guarding this window is enough for me.
Solitude is what keeps my shape.
If you leave, the shape falls apart.

lines.zh: 地上的东西会破坏形状
lines.en: Things on the ground would ruin my shape.
I can see the sword you dropped.
I do not pick it up; I only look.
That iron glints beside your foot.
My hands are not made for holding things.
You bend to pick it up; I watch.
The dropped seed will sprout by morning.
I do not collect; I only remember.
Your pack is far too full.
Let it rot there in the soil.
Your line of sight lands on me.

lines.zh: 从你看见我开始，就算数
lines.en: It counts from the moment you saw me.
No need to chase; sooner or later you walk over.
You blinked; I mark it down.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命，你慢慢来
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health; take your time.
A hundred armor plates await your sword.
You raised the torch; I saw it clearly.

lines.zh: 这个形态只准备给一个人
lines.en: This form was prepared for one person only.
You turned around; our account begins.
Do not pretend you did not see me.
Your breathing changed; I know.
I have memorized this face.
The sound under your pillow is me.
You have been written down.

lines.zh: 你的目光先到，就算找到我
lines.en: Your gaze arrives first, so I count as found.

lines.zh: 现在你是我的了，慢慢地
lines.en: You are mine now, and there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的脸转一度
lines.en: Each step you take turns my face one degree.
I travel along wherever your gaze goes.
You hide behind the door; I count the planks.
The more you look, the closer I get.
This shape cannot run at all.
Your firelight sways across the wall.
You are inside the window; I am outside.
Do not put out the light; I would change shape.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步，却看不见人
lines.en: You hear steps and see nobody there.
I am waiting for you to open the door.
Distance means little to me.

lines.zh: 你的影子里有我的一角
lines.en: A corner of me is inside your shadow.
The night is long, and I have nothing else to do.
You have backed into the corner; good.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子走，不出声
lines.en: I walk with your shadow, silent.

lines.zh: 你走两步，我的形状补上缺口
lines.en: Two steps, and my shape fills the gap.

lines.zh: 你的火把扫过来，我就贴墙
lines.en: Your torch sweeps past, so I press to the wall.

lines.zh: 我按住了门把手，别试了
lines.en: I am holding the door handle; don't try.

lines.zh: 你听见的气声是我在呼吸
lines.en: That soft hiss is me breathing.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头那个轮廓是我
lines.en: The shape at the hall's end is me.
This one is light; barely a touch.
You are struck, and your eyes stay open.
I watch you, and only then my hand falls.
The shape thins when it exerts force.

lines.zh: 你格挡的位置偏了一寸
lines.en: Your block was off by one inch.
The wound appears where I looked.
Do not close your eyes; I want you watching.
You pull back, and the shape steadies.
My hand lands later than its sound.
You are breathing louder than the water.
Come closer, and I will reach you.
The smell of blood sharpens my shape.
This blow leaves you alive.
You are still standing; I am glad.

lines.zh: 我只碰到你的肩膀，你就僵了
lines.en: I only touch your shoulder, and you freeze.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，却让你记住我
lines.en: This blow is light, yet it makes you remember me.

lines.zh: 有人点了灯，于是我出现
lines.en: Someone lit a lamp, so I appeared.
I was there the moment you looked up.
The fog gathers itself into a human shape.
A shadow formed in the corner first.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命慢慢填满
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health slowly fills in.
A hundred plates close one layer at a time.
The air in the room cools first.
I have no voice, only a shape.
A hand comes through the gap first.
You turn, and I have just finished forming.
Tonight's fog is very cooperative.

lines.zh: 我从你的记忆里走出来
lines.en: I walk out of your memory.
The lamp is lit, so here I am.
Do not ask how long I have been here.

lines.zh: 你吹熄灯那一秒，我成形
lines.en: In the second you blow out the lamp, I take shape.

lines.zh: 镜上的水汽先散，然后是我
lines.en: The mist on the mirror clears, then comes me.

lines.zh: 屋外的风停了一瞬，我在这
lines.en: The wind outside paused; here I am.
First came my shadow, then a body.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙渗出一道痕
lines.en: The wall behind you seeps a dark seam.

lines.zh: 这个形态只在夜里站得住
lines.en: This form only holds together at night.
The flame makes my edges glow.
I scattered slightly when I landed.
My shape is clearer underwater.
The blast scatters me into thin mist.
The arrow goes straight through and leaves a gap.

lines.zh: 符文的字在我皮肤上爬
lines.en: Rune letters crawl across my skin.
This shape has no need to eat.

lines.zh: 雷光里我的脸露了一瞬
lines.en: For an instant the lightning showed my face.
In the void, nothing watches me.
